# bioexcel/biobb_amber/pdb4amber_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) pdb4amber tool module.

Analyse PDB files and clean them for further usage, especially with the LEaP programs of Amber, using pdb4amber tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pdb4amberRun](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pdb4amber.html#module-pdb4amber.pdb4amber_run) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_PDB4AMBER_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/pdb4amber_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_PDB4AMBER_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Input 3D structure PDB file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output 3D structure PDB file |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pdb4amberRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_PDB4AMBER_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [remove_hydrogens: false]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remove_hydrogens` | boolean | false | Remove hydrogen atoms from the PDB file. |
| `remove_waters` | boolean | false | Remove water molecules from the PDB file. |
| `constant_pH` | boolean | false | Rename ionizable residues e.g. GLU,ASP,HIS for constant pH simulation. |
| `reduce` | boolean | false | Run Reduce first to add hydrogen atoms. |
| `binary_path` | string | "pdb4amber" | Path to the pdb4amber executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
